name: Disable Automatic Restart After Updates
description: Prevents Windows Update from automatically restarting the PC while a user is signed in to avoid interrupted gaming sessions or work tasks.

description_i18n.en: Prevents Windows Update from automatically restarting the PC while a user is signed in to avoid interrupted gaming sessions or work tasks.
description_i18n.de: Verhindert, dass Windows Update den PC automatisch neu startet, während ein Benutzer angemeldet ist, um Gaming-Sessions oder Arbeitssitzungen zu schützen.
description_i18n.fr: Empêche Windows Update de redémarrer automatiquement le PC lorsqu'un utilisateur est connecté pour éviter d'interrompre les sessions de jeu ou les tâches.

warnings.title: Policy override possible
warnings.message: Some enterprise, domain, or MDM policies may override this setting and force automatic restarts regardless of the tweak state

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets the registry value NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers to 1 under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU This tells Windows Update not to automatically reboot the system after scheduled update installations while a user is logged in
